notes: Readings by Xiaohui Chen on 2026-10-10, taken for the Module 6 lab (assignments/assignment6/measurements.csv, reviewed in assignments/assignment6/review/MEASUREMENT-REVIEW.md) and copied unchanged to evidence/M1/M1.T9/measurements-xiaohui-chen-2026-10-10.csv. UPDATE 2026-10-16: car.json is now built from evidence/M1/M1.T9/measurements-2026-10-16-with-plate-cad.csv, which is that copy plus superseding rows for the plate outline from a classmate's CAD of the same Emo chassis plate (instrument 'CAD ...': width 147.92 mm, narrow strip 100 mm, wing depth 34.35 mm, front arc R135.14 mm, front corner fillets R8 mm) and B1/B2/B4 fitted to the CAD plate length 206.98 mm (130.49 / 76.49 / 76.49 mm; instrument 'fit ...'). The wheel, track, caster, camera, IMU, height and mass readings are unchanged: the CAD models the plate only. Car on the floor, battery off, camera fitted, no USB cable. DEVIATIONS from the M1.T9 procedure, each for Xiaohui to accept or redo: (1) ONE reading per quantity, not three, so there is no repeatability check; uncertainty = 2 mm per ruler reading, 5 mm for readings given as 'around', 1 g per scale reading, with these exceptions: at least 3 mm for every x measured from the axle line, because the axle line itself is located to about 3 mm (review #15; rows B1, B2, B3, B4 and S1_imu_board_centre_x get 3 mm, while the 'around' rows C2, C2b and S3_lens_x keep 5 mm), 4 mm for the 2026-10-10 B5b reading (review #7; that reading is superseded since 2026-10-16), 0.5 mm for a CAD dimension (an allowance, not a measured tolerance), and root-sum-square of 1 g and 1 g for the two-scale mass; propagated root-sum-square into derived values. (2) NO 5-revolution roll-out: wheel_diameter_m is the direct, unloaded tyre diameter (row W1_tyre_diameter_direct), not the effective rolling diameter under load; rollout_left_m, rollout_right_m, wheel_diameter_left_m and wheel_diameter_right_m are omitted. (3) Encoder counts per wheel revolution postponed (they need the Pico): counts_per_rev_left, counts_per_rev_right and ticks_per_wheel_rev are omitted. (4) front_overhang_m was measured with NO USB cable in the ESP32-CAM; re-measure with the operating cable (M3.T1). (5) imu_axes not recorded (no photo of the BNO055's printed axes). (6) The camera is not calibrated (M1.T7): lens_x_m, lens_y_m and lens_z_m are ruler readings of the lens position. (7) chassis_length_m, chassis_width_m and chassis_height_m are NOT the whole-car bounding box that M1.T9 step 3 asks for. They describe the main body without the drive wheels and without the camera stand, which is what the URDF chassis box (M2.T4 step 5, body_width) draws and what M2.T3 maps to body_width_m (kinsim's contact corners): length = front_overhang_m + rear_overhang_m = 0.214 m (0.21449 m since 2026-10-16; 0.215 m before) (also the whole car's length, except that the caster swung fully forward reaches x = 0.140 m, see corners); width = the widest plate point, the rear wing, 0.148 m (CAD 147.92 mm since 2026-10-16; the 150 mm ruler reading before) (the whole car is 0.160 m wide over the tyres = track_outer_m); height = gearbox bottoms (30 mm above the floor) to battery-holder top (66 mm) = 0.036 m (the whole car reaches about 0.100 m above the floor at the camera-stand top, row B10_camera_stand_top_h, 'around 10 cm'). (8) corners, and therefore sweep_radius_m, rest on one ASSUMPTION: the ESP32-CAM front corners and the plate-front corners take y = +-(measured width) / 2, i.e. those parts are assumed centred on y = 0 (their sideways offsets were not measured). Until 2026-10-16 the farthest corner, which set sweep_radius_m = 0.140218 m, was a square plate-front corner (0.131, +-0.050). Since 2026-10-16 the plate-front corners follow the CAD's rounded front (an R135.14 arc with R8 corner fillets, apex at B1): (0.1229, +-0.0447) m, r = 0.1308 m; the farthest point is now the caster swung fully forward (0.140, 0), so sweep_radius_m = 0.140 m needs no centring assumption. The stick antenna was not measured (review #9). CONVENTIONS: x and y from the axle midpoint, +x toward the camera/caster end, +y to the robot's left. lens_z_m (lens centre) is a height above the FLOOR, as M1.T9 step 3 ('measure as M1.T7 step 8') and M1.T7 step 8 define the camera's z_m. imu_z_m is the BNO055 board top surface above the AXLE midpoint, as M1.T9 step 3 defines the IMU position ('from the axle midpoint'): row S1_imu_board_top_h (60 mm above the floor) minus wheel_diameter_m / 2 (33.5 mm) = 0.0265 m, uncertainty root-sum-square of 2 mm and 1 mm = 0.0022 m. The URDF's base_link is at axle height, wheel_diameter_m / 2 above the floor. caster_x_m is the trailing caster's floor contact ('around'); the swivel pivot is at about 0.120 m (row C3) and the swung-forward wheel front at about 0.140 m (row C2b), which conflicts with a 20 mm swivel offset (review #4, open). mass_kg: whole car with batteries and camera, no cable, = 142 g on the caster + 364 g on the drive wheels.
